{{Capricorn}}
Capricorn 25 is the 53rd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 25th day of Capricorn, and it is a Thursday. It corresponds to ISO week 8, weekday 4.

Its informal Japanese name is 2宮25日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 53|Chapter 53]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152073}}.
